image_description: A white minibus (likely a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter or similar model) parked on a paved brick surface. The vehicle features a high roof, a row of side windows, and standard van wheels. There is a logo on the front hood and some text/graphics on the rear side window. The background includes a building with scaffolding or fencing and some greenery.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof van silhouette, distinct from full-size buses, with proportions consistent with a minibus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, along with multiple side windows extending along the passenger cabin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a high roofline. The driver's door is visible at the front, and the sliding track for the passenger door is visible in the mid-body section.
The horizontal seam and handle mechanism typical of a sliding side door are visible on the passenger side.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout, typical for this class of vehicle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is occluded by the angle of the photograph; only the side and front-three-quarters are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is painted white with a small logo on the hood and graphics on the rear side window, fitting the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wheels are proportional to the vehicle body, appearing to be standard steel rims with hubcaps, consistent with a commercial van/minibus.
The window configuration and overall size suggest a capacity within the 4-10 passenger range.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific make/model classification and ensure it aligns with the 'minibus' taxonomy rather than a standard cargo van or full-size bus.
To verify the structural integrity of the vehicle's boxy shape and ensure correct spatial separation from the complex background (fencing/building).
To check for common AI artifacts such as melting wheel rims, fused window frames, or irregular door seams.
To analyze the legibility and structural correctness of the logo on the hood and the text/graphics on the side window, which are prone to AI gibberish.

focus_areas: Wheel rim symmetry and tire contact patches
Window frame straightness and reflection consistency
Door handle and sliding track geometry
Logo and text legibility on hood and side window
Background fence line continuity behind the vehicle
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the side window and the logo on the hood. AI generators often distort these small details. Also, verify that the wheel rims are perfectly circular and not elliptical due to perspective errors, and check that the sliding door track is parallel to the ground.
